title: ‘We consulted with him [Putin] regarding IMPORTANT ISSUES we have in the region’ — Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council
text:
‘We consulted with him [Putin] regarding IMPORTANT ISSUES we have in the region’ — Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council"

"‘Important discussions are being raised regarding the POST-WAR PERIOD, especially concerning REGIONAL SECURITY ARRANGEMENTS’
